name: Blocking job waiters
why: Still solid on 5bfffec: waitBatch and waitCrawl retry a network error, 408, 429 or 5xx while polling (after 1, 2, 4, 8, then 10 s or a Retry-After of 60 s or less, maxRetries default 5), throw other errors at once, end a request in flight when timeoutMs runs out and throw WaitTimeoutError with the task id and the last status (packages/sdk/src/client.ts:82-112, 175-189, 414-455); crawlAndWait and batchAndWait collect the results. The audit's check passes (A27), and T02 retries through injected faults on a real crawl.
evidence_tests: packages/sdk/test/client.test.ts (waits for a crawl to finish, and stops waiting after timeoutMs; retries a network error, 408, 429 and 5xx while waiting, backing off or following Retry-After; rethrows other 4xx at once, and a transient error once its retries or the timeout run out; ends a status request still in flight when timeoutMs runs out, and checks its options; crawlAndWait and batchAndWait return the final status with every page, error and item) | packages/api/test/crawlLifecycle.test.ts | packages/api/test/batch.test.ts | packages/mcp/test/tools.test.ts
evidence_real_site: Audit check: A27 6/6 (books.toscrape.com, 20 pages, polled every second, all 20 steps; a 1 s wait throws WaitTimeoutError with the crawl id). T02 7/7, also A26 7/7, A28 7/7, T03 6/6. Record runs/2026-09-30-main-5bfffec.md (source commit 5bfffec).
docs: Match: README.md:142, docs/batch-scrape.md:23, docs/onboarding.md:215, apps/public-web/content/reference.md:86.
remaining_gaps: The listing phase of crawlAndWait / batchAndWait is neither retried nor bounded by timeoutMs | a pollIntervalMs above 2^31-1 ms is accepted and then polls at once (client.ts:183-189, 500) | a malformed baseUrl throws TypeError, which is retried as a network error | CrawlCollected and BatchCollected are not exported from packages/sdk/src/index.ts | no MCP wait_crawl | paused is not terminal (documented)
